run_convert_ssg_predictions: run the script to merge SSG predictions into a master JSONL file with predicted facts
convert_predictions_to_output: convert SSG prediction JSON into an output JSONL file augmented with predicted facts for each query
inject_predicted_facts: inject predicted facts from SSG output into queries in a master database JSONL file
merge_ssg_output: merge semantic selection graph predictions indexed by db and question ID into master queries
parse_predictions_by_id: parse a predictions JSON file and index instances by database ID and question ID tuples
